unresolved.detail: sqlglot 30.6.0 returns the multi-statement batch as a single IfBlock and the CREATE VIEW with its 9-column projection never appears in the AST. The OpenMetadata collate-sqllineage chain (sqlglot → sqlfluff → sqlparse) raises UnsupportedStatementException on the IF EXISTS / DROP VIEW / GO header before reaching the CREATE VIEW. Net effect: 0 column edges, 0 upstream tables, even though db.YEARLY_TARGETS_FriendlyNames and db.YEARLY_TARGETS_DIVISION_FriendlyNames are visibly the real sources of [DBAPP].[WFA_YEARLY_TARGETS_ModelView].
